Game Overview

In School Days First Day of School, the core idea is straightforward: step into "School Days First Day of School," where you navigate hallways, meet classmates, and take on teaching challenges. Experience the excitement of academia with engaging interactions and dynamic scenarios, promising both nostalgia and new adventures in an authentic school setting.
